payload.text: 0.1.9's cut takes route C past devbin 0348, on hv's ruling (decision 3 on hv's board). Just before the cut hv runs bin/devbin install and bin/devbin use opt, so doctor passes with the link on opt, then bin/devbin release 0.1.9; after the publish, brew upgrade ccusage, bin/devbin use brew and T10's version check. vc writes these steps for hv together with ST0003/WP06's rollout, whose first steps they share. devbin-vc and dc are told; devbin 0349 (LICENSE in the archives) waits for a later devbin, as dc's hold 9.
